_comment: Hand-curated voice regions for the cloud (Gemini 3.8) backend. Each region names one Extended Voice Library accent; tools/generate_npc_voices.py builds its male and female voice pools from the tools/voice-library.json snapshot and writes them to src/main/resources/voice-regions.json. A profile layer in tools/profiles.json names a region with 'voiceRegion' next to its 'accent', and an NPC whose winning accent carries a region is voiced from that region's pool for its gender, keeping one voice for life. 'playerKeywords' match the player's typed accent (case-insensitive, whole words) so the player is voiced from the first matching region in file order; the broad SOUTHERN_ENGLISH region comes last so a more specific region always wins. 'exclude' drops library voices rejected by ear.
